text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Winning Live." The dream stage for 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing at center stage is proof of 
victory. Only a handful of girls get to 
earn the microphone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Savoring that tightly grasped joy, the 
Umamusume pour their hearts into singing 
the lyrics.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Show gratitude to the fans who have 
supported me all this time.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
G-Good work today, Senpai. Um, it's a 
shame about what happened today, but...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I was shining with all my might, 
right? Even if I was just a backup dancer 
like always...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...You're amazing, Senpai. How can you 
keep doing your best with a smile like 
that?"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Nobody would notice if a backup dancer 
slacked off. I could just wait until I 
finally become the center someday—"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not true. The people who 
support me will support me no matter where 
I am.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
Just as you watched over me today. That is 
why I want to answer your expectations 
with everything I have, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Hello. Do you know why Winning 
Lives started in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"It's because an Umamusume who wins a race 
wants to express her gratitude to the fans 
who cheered for her, right?"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
That's right. To show off my finest 
appearance and convey my gratitude to the 
fans who supported me.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
Still, it seems the true beginning was a 
little different. You see—...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
(Senior's smile back then was so dazzling 
and genuine.)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
(Which is why it looked a little 
bittersweet.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As their debut race draws near, the 
Umamusume's practice sessions become just 
as intense for the Winning Live as they 
are for the race itself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I happened to pass by the 
stage—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's put more emotion into our 
performance!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh... but it's just practice today, 
right? You don't gotta go that tryhard.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Didn't the teacher say to practice like 
it's the real thing? So smile more, okay?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...No way. If we're treating this like 
the real thing, smiling is even more out 
of the question."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't this the choreo for the back 
dancers?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ! ...That may be true, but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You know, I don't want to get comfortable 
with this dance. Because if I can just 
smile and dance it normally, I feel like 
I'll never reach center position for the 
rest of my life.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Even so, if I'm assigned this position, 
I'll dance properly—without getting in the 
lead's way.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not right! We don't perform 
live shows just to become the center, do 
we?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of everyone coming to watch 
us, how about we practice just one more 
time?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...! You only say that because you—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume kicked off the ground with 
immense force and tried to grab Smart 
Falcon. —I really can't just stand by and 
watch this anymore!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pulled Smart Falcon and the others apart 
and somehow managed to calm them down.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry! For dragging you into this so 
suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I'm really sorry. I need to 
apologize to her later, too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...I realized it myself, too. That maybe 
I got a little too heated."
choice_data_list: Still, what you said was right too.
But what you said was right too

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Thanks for backing me up. Still, 
what they said was right too, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Would it be better if Winning Lives 
just didn't have centers or back dancers 
at all?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
B-But! Winning Lives shine so brightly 
because everyone competed with all their 
might. That's why everyone longs to stand 
at center stage...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haaah... That's true, isn't it.

"In that case...!! Why don't we bring back 
the Grand Live!?"
"Trainer over there, and Smart Falcon."

The way you feel is entirely justified. 
Therefore, I shall resolve this issue 
myself!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh, wha, what...!? Who are... you?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me for not introducing myself 
sooner. I am Light Hello.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I am the event producer and the person in 
charge of the Grand Live Revival Project!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This was how I met the mysterious event 
producer, Light Hello.
